summary.text: Leigh Davis is a Democratic state representative from Great Barrington who has represented the 3rd Berkshire District since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She is the first woman elected state representative for the 3rd Berkshire District and previously served on the Great Barrington Selectboard.

paragraphs.text: Davis was born in Washington, D.C., and holds a B.S. from Ithaca College and an M.A. from the National University of Ireland, Galway.

She worked as a film and television editor in Los Angeles and later spent ten years in higher education as a tenured lecturer and chair of the Department of Film and Television at the Galway-Mayo Institute of Technology in Ireland.
She later served as Director of Development for the Eagle Mill Redevelopment.
Davis served two terms as vice chair of the Great Barrington Selectboard before joining the Legislature.
She took office on January 1, 2025, and advanced from the Democratic primary on September 1, 2026.

She serves on the House Committees on Climate Action and Sustainability and on Federal Funding, Policy and Accountability and the Joint Committees on Election Laws and on State Administration and Regulatory Oversight.
Her legislative biography says her work centers on economic development and essential services, schools, farming, housing, environmental sustainability and rural communities.
